quarterly_data.quarter: WUS Printed Circuit annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: revenue RMB 18,945,220,585, up 42.00% year over year; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 3,822,306,272, up 47.74%. PCB business revenue RMB 18,143,308,261, up 41.31%, with PCB gross margin rising to 36.91% (up 1.06 percentage points) on a better product mix. Quarterly revenue: Q1 RMB 4,037,627,327, Q2 RMB 4,456,244,556, Q3 RMB 5,018,518,348, Q4 RMB 5,432,830,354; Q4 net profit attributable RMB 1,104,688,277. The company says revenue and profit both reached record highs on strong demand for its PCBs in AI servers, HPC, high-speed network switches and routers and smart vehicles.

quarterly_data.quarter: WUS Printed Circuit annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report, PCB revenue by application: data communications RMB 14,656,300,288 (up 45.21%, gross margin 39.68%, up 1.33 points); smart automotive RMB 3,044,579,100 (up 26.41%, gross margin 22.84%, down 1.61 points on competition and raw-material cost pressure); industrial control and other RMB 442,428,873 (gross margin 42.10%). Within data communications: high-speed network switches and associated routing about RMB 81.69 hundred million (the fastest-growing segment, up about 109.89%); AI servers and HPC about RMB 30.06 hundred million; general-purpose servers about RMB 25.40 hundred million; wireless networks and other about RMB 9.41 hundred million. Export PCB revenue RMB 15,542,868,460 (gross margin 38.34%), domestic RMB 2,600,439,801; revenue exported directly to the United States was no more than 5%, mainly engineering-qualification samples and small batches. The company says high-end capacity is tight because building and ramping it takes time, so it allocates high-end capacity first to the core products of its leading customers that need the highest reliability.
quarterly_data.figure: Data-com RMB 14,656,300,288 (+45.21%, GM 39.68%); switches/routing ~RMB 81.69 hundred million (+~109.89%); AI server/HPC ~30.06; general servers ~25.40; wireless/other ~9.41 (RMB hundred million); auto RMB 3,044,579,100 (+26.41%, GM 22.84%)

quarterly_data.quarter: WUS Printed Circuit annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: automotive intelligence and electrification PCB revenue was about RMB 11.79 hundred million, up about 114.62%, led by millimeter-wave radar, HDI-based driver-assistance and smart-cockpit domain controller boards and P2Pack (embedded power-chip packaging) boards; automotive safety systems and other about RMB 18.65 hundred million. With rapid ramp of 48V-platform P2Pack PCBs, revenue of the Changzhou subsidiary Shengweice rose about 107.63% and it turned profitable; the company says it is the only maker in the industry producing P2Pack PCBs in high volume (company claim). It is testing high-voltage P2Pack products for 800V automotive drive platforms with several carmakers and their core suppliers, and is exploring P2Pack PCBs in data-center applications with core data-communications customers to shorten the chip-to-PCB heat path and raise power density.
quarterly_data.figure: Auto intelligence/electrification ~RMB 11.79 hundred million (+~114.62%); auto safety/other ~RMB 18.65 hundred million; Shengweice revenue +~107.63%

quarterly_data.quarter: WUS Printed Circuit annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report, 2026 plan: the Thailand subsidiary posted 2025 revenue of RMB 289,041,168 and a net loss of RMB 139,870,724. At the Thailand base, more than 70% of the data-communications division's overseas customers have completed certification, with the rest progressing; Q1 2026 capacity utilization exceeded 90%; a targeted capacity upgrade is expected to release in Q2 2026 and the next phase of capacity is being planned. The automotive division started trial production in Q4 2025, completed sample validation and entered mass production in 2026, with capacity ramping, and is extending into high-end HDI for data communications. The company aims to accelerate volume introduction of AI server and high-speed network products in Thailand and to steadily reach its operating-profit target for the Thailand base; domestically it plans targeted expansion of bottleneck high-end processes and faster construction of high-end expansion projects in phases.
quarterly_data.figure: Thailand 2025 revenue RMB 289,041,168, net loss RMB 139,870,724; >70% of overseas data-com customers certified; Q1 2026 utilization >90%; upgrade capacity expected Q2 2026

quarterly_data.quarter: WUS Printed Circuit annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: the company says that as high-end PCBs move to ultra- and extremely-low-loss resins, HVLP (very-low-profile) copper foil and special high-performance glass cloth, process barriers and yield bottlenecks leave some high-end raw materials capacity-limited and in tight supply for a period; it joins end customers' product development very early to qualify new materials and secure priority allocation, and holds strategic safety stock of key materials.
